_note: Terminal render configuration template — canonical version. Maps response media types to render instructions. Place in your server's config/ directory. Swap only this file to adapt to a different terminal — no code changes needed.
_when_loaded: Level 5+ (self-hosted endpoint). Level 0-4 endpoints handle rendering internally or expose pre-rendered URLs.
_design: Not a step type — a configuration item. When any instruction or path produces a media URL, the render config decides how to display it. The same instruction output can render differently on different terminals.

<trigger_name>.match: <description of what triggers this rule (e.g., response contains image URL)>
<trigger_name>.proxy: <optional proxy instruction, null if not needed. Use {url} placeholder>

detection_order: <ordered list of trigger names — first match wins. Put specific types before generic fallbacks>

_proxy_notes.why: External CDN URLs may have signing expiry, CORS restrictions, or platform incompatibility. Proxy downloads to local workspace and serves via /media/ — URLs never expire, fully cross-platform.
_proxy_notes.how: media;download,<url> → download to disk (SHA256 dedup) → return local /media?path= URL → resource;render from local URL
_proxy_notes.local_skip: Local file paths and data URIs skip the proxy step — already local or self-contained.

image.match: response contains image/gif/png/jpg URL or data URI
image.description: Static images and GIFs — proxy then render
